causes.none: We did not find a clear cause of the water shortage.

precipitation_deficit.title: Too little rain
precipitation_deficit.description: Less rain fell than usual for this time of year.

high_evaporative_demand.title: Heat and wind dry the field
high_evaporative_demand.description: With high temperature, sun and wind, plants and soil lose more water than usual.

low_soil_retention.title: The soil holds little water
low_soil_retention.description: Light soil releases water quickly, so the reserve does not last long.

surface_runoff.title: Water runs off the surface
surface_runoff.description: The field lies on a slope, so part of the rain runs off before it soaks in.

fast_drainage.title: Ditches drain water quickly
fast_drainage.description: Ditches carry water away faster than the soil can absorb it.

no_landscape_retention.title: Nothing nearby holds water
no_landscape_retention.description: There are no ponds, wetlands or trees nearby that hold water.

crop_sensitivity.title: The crop is sensitive to water shortage now
crop_sensitivity.description: At this growth stage the plant needs a lot of water, so a shortage cuts the yield faster.

zoneKinds.drying: the place that dries out first

small_pond.name: Small pond
small_pond.description: A pond at the lowest point collects rain and snowmelt for dry weeks.

ditch_weir.name: Ditch weir
ditch_weir.description: A simple weir raises the water level in the ditch and slows its outflow from the field.

protect_wetland.name: Protect the wetland
protect_wetland.description: Leave the wet spot undrained. It works like a sponge for the whole area.

grassed_waterway.name: Grassed waterway
grassed_waterway.description: A grass strip where water flows holds it back and protects the soil from erosion.

field_margin_trees.name: Tree strip on the field edge
field_margin_trees.description: Trees and shrubs shield the field from wind and reduce evaporation.

contour_farming.name: Farming across the slope
contour_farming.description: Ploughing and sowing across the slope keep the rain on the field.

cover_crop.name: Cover crop
cover_crop.description: Plants after harvest protect the soil from drying and add organic matter.

mulch_residue.name: Straw mulch
mulch_residue.description: Straw left on the field reduces evaporation from the soil.

reduced_tillage.name: Reduced tillage
reduced_tillage.description: Less ploughing means less dried-out soil and a better soil structure.

organic_matter.name: More humus in the soil
organic_matter.description: Manure, compost and crop residues help the soil hold water.

subsoiling.name: Subsoiling
subsoiling.description: Breaking the compacted layer under the topsoil lets water soak in deeper.

crop_choice.name: A different crop or variety
crop_choice.description: A species or variety less sensitive to drought lowers the risk of losses.

recommendations.zoneRest: Applies to the rest of the field, outside the marked spots

limitationItems.sample_data: The report uses sample data. The results do not describe this field.
limitationItems.meteo_missing: Weather data is missing, so the water balance cannot be calculated.
limitationItems.meteo_coarse_grid: Weather comes from a grid with cells tens of kilometres wide. Local storms may not match.
limitationItems.soil_estimated: The soil type is estimated from maps, not measured on the field.
limitationItems.soil_missing: Soil data is missing. We assumed a typical soil for the area.
limitationItems.terrain_missing: The terrain model is missing, so we do not assess runoff.
limitationItems.terrain_coarse: The terrain model is coarse. Small dips may not be visible.
limitationItems.hydro_missing: Data on ditches and streams nearby is missing.
limitationItems.vegetation_missing: There are no cloud-free satellite images from this period.
limitationItems.vegetation_few_pixels: The field is small or narrow, so the satellite image covers few points.
limitationItems.vegetation_before_archive: There are no comparable satellite images for such an old date.
limitationItems.forecast_missing: The weather forecast is missing, so we do not suggest when to water.
limitationItems.out_of_season: This day is outside the agricultural drought season (21 March – 30 September).
limitationItems.crop_not_monitored: There are no official drought thresholds for this crop. The assessment is based on the soil water reserve.
limitationItems.balance_estimated: We calculate the water balance with our own method, so it may differ from IUNG reports.
limitationItems.current_boundaries: The parcel boundaries are current. They may have been different on the analysis day.
limitationItems.no_in_situ_measurement: Nobody measured soil moisture on site. These are calculations from remote data.
limitationItems.field_verification_needed: Before deciding, check the soil on the field, e.g. with a spade at root depth.
limitationItems.sample_data_partial: Some of the data is still sample data (the box at the top of the report says which). Treat those parts as illustrative.
limitationItems.drainage_structures_unknown: Maps do not show weirs or culverts on ditches. Before planning a ditch weir, check on site what is already on the ditch.
